description: This file is a PHP class implementation named 'test.youtrackrestInterface.class.php', which appears to integrate with the YouTrack issue tracker API. It includes configuration setup, class instantiation, and method calls related to retrieving and manipulating issues within YouTrack.

classes.name: test.youtrackrestInterface
